It was not very special, but it is delicious enought to try beef brisket noodle. They have quite much of quantity inside the bowl. It was good enough to win the hangover. Try the noodle with the fried bread. If I have chance to visit here again, I will do it. And I can introduce here to my friends too.

The pho tastes amazing! It comes with a nice mix of greens, just like you'd expect. The soup has a delightful, light flavor that's still rich and satisfying. Each pho restaurant has its own special twist, and I absolutely love exploring them all!

I had the all kinds of beef phô and it was great. The service is good and staffs are friendly and helpful. They don't speak English but speak enough just to take the order. I didn't realize their Michelin stars until I left.
